about: The Color Palette Generator creates harmonious color schemes based on color theory principles. Generate complementary, triadic, analogous, and other professional color combinations for your design projects.
This tool helps designers and artists create cohesive color palettes that work well together, ensuring visual harmony and professional aesthetics in web design, branding, and digital art.
howToUse: Select a base color using the color picker
Choose a color harmony type (complementary, triadic, etc.)
Adjust the number of colors in your palette
Export or copy the complete color palette

faqs.question: What are color harmonies?
faqs.answer: Color harmonies are combinations of colors that are pleasing to the eye based on their relationships on the color wheel, such as complementary (opposite colors) or analogous (adjacent colors).

faqs.question: How many colors should be in a palette?
faqs.answer: Most effective palettes contain 3-5 colors. Too few colors may be limiting, while too many can create visual chaos. The optimal number depends on your specific project needs.

faqs.question: Can I check color accessibility?
faqs.answer: Yes, our tool includes accessibility checking to ensure your color combinations meet WCAG guidelines for contrast ratios and readability.

faqs.question: What export formats are available?
faqs.answer: You can export palettes as CSS variables, JSON, Adobe Swatch Exchange (ASE), or simple text lists in HEX, RGB, or HSL formats.
